skill.displayName: 不同方位倾斜面辐射量计算
skill.summary: Calculate solar radiation on tilted surfaces based on NASA POWER data. Supports user-defined tilt angle and azimuth angle. Outputs structured Excel files.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of solar-tilt-calculator.
- Calculates solar radiation on tilted surfaces using NASA POWER data and Hay's anisotropic model.
- Supports user-defined tilt and azimuth angles.
- Generates structured Excel output with radiation results, input parameters, and calculation details.
- Enables comparison between horizontal and tilted surfaces, highlighting annual and monthly radiation gains or losses.
